name: button
title: Button
description: Triggers an action. Not navigation; for links use asChild with an anchor.
docs: Ejected from @macaw-ds/ui@0.2.1. One primary button per view. Everything else is secondary or ghost. Label is a verb phrase: "Pay invoice", not "OK" or "Submit".

manifest.name: Button
manifest.purpose: Triggers an action. Not navigation; for links use asChild with an anchor.
manifest.description: The action primitive. Four variants carry the weight of an action (one primary per view), three sizes match the control heights, and `loading` turns the button busy without losing its label. Icon-only buttons require an accessible name at the type level.

variant.description: Visual weight. primary is the one main action on a view; secondary for the rest; ghost for low-emphasis actions in toolbars and rows; destructive for irreversible actions, always behind confirmation.

size.description: 28, 32 or 40 px tall. md is the default for forms and toolbars; sm inside table rows; lg for page-level calls to action.
size.a11y: All sizes meet the 24 px minimum target size (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8).

loading.description: Shows a spinner in place of the start icon, sets aria-busy and aria-disabled, and ignores clicks and form submits. The button stays focusable and the label stays visible.
loading.a11y: Keeps keyboard focus when an action starts: aria-disabled, not the disabled attribute. aria-busy is announced; the label is not replaced.

disabled.description: Not interactive. Prefer explaining why nearby.
disabled.a11y: Disabled buttons are skipped in the tab order; if the reason matters, show it as text.

iconOnly.description: Square button whose only child is an Icon. Requires aria-label.
iconOnly.a11y: TypeScript requires aria-label when iconOnly is true.

asChild.description: Render the child element (an anchor, a Next.js Link) with the button's styling.

a11y.role: button (or the child's role with asChild)
keyboard: Disabled buttons leave the tab order; loading buttons stay focusable and ignore activation
a11y.name: From the visible label (children). Icon-only buttons take it from aria-label, which TypeScript requires.
notes: Focus ring is 2 px outline with 2 px offset at 3:1 or better against every surface.
loading keeps the label visible and sets aria-busy; it never swaps the label for a spinner alone.
Use a real button for actions and an anchor (asChild) for navigation so assistive technology announces the right thing.
A disabled asChild link gets aria-disabled and its clicks are blocked, so it never navigates.

motion.description: Background and border colours ease on hover and press; the loading spinner rotates.

rules: One primary button per view. Everything else is secondary or ghost.
Label is a verb phrase: "Pay invoice", not "OK" or "Submit".
Icon-only buttons set iconOnly and aria-label.
Destructive actions sit behind a confirmation step.
Navigation uses asChild with an anchor; never a button with an onClick that routes.
dos: Group a primary and a secondary button with gap-2, primary last in LTR layouts.
Use size="sm" ghost buttons for row actions in tables.
donts: Do not pass className or style; use a variant or propose one in DECISIONS.md.
Do not place two primary buttons side by side.
Do not use loading for operations under 300 ms; it flickers.

examples.name: Icon only
examples.description: Square, with a required accessible name.
